data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (arXiv advanced search with topic, category and year, then first result's title and author, then Semantic Scholar citation count, then a note in the same format) with the right parameters, but it adds a "field = Title" detail, gives vague navigation options, doesn't mention opening or closing the new tab, and says "newest" and "save" where the true flow uses the first result and Enter.
